docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Harvard Oriental Series translation of the Yoga-sūtras with the commentary of Vyāsa and the gloss of Vācaspati Miśra, with a long introduction and notes (1914).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The yoga-system of Patañjali; or, The ancient Hindu doctrine of concentration of mind, embracing the mnemonic rules, called Yoga-sutras, of Patañjali, and the comment, called Yoga-bhashya · Woods, James Haughton, 1864-1935, Vyasa, Vachaspati Misra · 1914, 434 scanned pages. Published 1914; James Haughton Woods died 1935 and the series editor Charles Rockwell Lanman 1941; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
